subject: EOQ priority check — Redwood + StellarApps
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 15:08:00 -0000
Subject: Redwood demo recap + mutual next steps

Thanks again for taking time today — enjoyed the demo and the discussion about where Redwood could help lower inference costs and standardize inference across teams. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

1) What we covered
- Serving latency targets: sub-200ms P95 for interactive features
- Cost targets: reduce per-token cost ~30% via batching + quantization suggestions
- Compliance: StellarApps needs SOC 2 + VPC option for production

2) Mutual action plan (proposal)
- Redwood: send a tailored MAP (attached) + SOC2 summary and example SLA by EOD Friday (6/26)
- StellarApps: confirm stakeholders (procurement + infra) and target decision date (you mentioned an infra decision in early July)
- Next call: 30-min technical + procurement sync week of 6/29 if that still works

3) Ask / decisions needed from you
- Is procurement the right owner to loop in? If so, please share a primary contact.
- Is July 7th still the target for an infra decision (so we can align Dedicated capacity timelines)?

Attachment: StellarApps-MAP.pdf (application/pdf)

If helpful I can put together a short pricing snapshot for your expected monthly tokens and a canary rollout plan for a low-risk pilot. Thanks — I’ll follow up with the SOC2 summary separately.

Best,
